subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should `resolvePollMaxSelections` formally reject zero- and one-option polls with the same error as `normalizePollInput`, rather than preserve its current numeric return behavior for invalid inputs?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small and the helper is not in a shipped tag, but it changes behavior exposed through the public plugin SDK, so the durable invalid-input contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the shared invariant
options.body: Approve throwing the established minimum-options error so SDK and channel callers fail before an impossible poll reaches delivery.

options.title: Preserve permissive helper behavior
options.body: Keep the helper numeric-only and require validation at callers if maintainers want this public helper not to throw.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared invariant
recommendation.body: Approve throwing the established minimum-options error so SDK and channel callers fail before an impossible poll reaches delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the helper and are the strongest available history lead for its intended public contract.
